description.narrative: The Trade Policy Programme aims to support the EAC Partner States improve their trade regulatory environment and contribute to the reduction of trade barriers and Improved Business Competitiveness in the region. It entails supporting the Partner States develop a regional common external trade policy to respond to challenge of multiple membership to regional economic blocs by EAC Partner States, assisting EAC PS align national to regional trade policies among others.
